title: Reading Drill — Testing a shallow pond ramp — Building a comparison
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Testing a shallow pond ramp — Building a comparison
passages.body:
**A** The wildlife centre staff had been asked to investigate animals reaching the edge but being unable to leave the water in Cairnford. Its first task was to decide which signs of improvement could be compared between sites. It settled on successful exits, because the same measure could be applied in the original setting and at a second location.

**B** During a ten-week comparison, the team used daytime observations at both places. It recorded outcomes separately for each site. Because fluctuating water height might influence the figures, the team used a column in the record to show when that condition was present. The surveys included quiet periods as well as busy ones.

**C** The team then put forward a rougher ramp surface. Its report asked for another comparison after the change had been tried. This would distinguish a genuine effect from an improvement that could have occurred anyway. The report did not assume that the more successful site before the change would be the better site afterwards.
